section.p: This method does not guarantee the reliability of data transmission. If a data packet is not received within five seconds after being sent, the SDK discards the packet. Compared with the createDataStream method, this method is suitable for scenarios with high real-time requirements but tolerable data loss.

section.note: Each user can create up to five data streams during the lifecycle of . The data streams are destroyed when you leave the channel. To use them again, you need to recreate them.
